_meta.name: l2m-product-gaps
_meta.notes: Close the remaining product-side known gaps (L2M wave). 14 rows promotable: protect fallback (Rust), compare/combine array shape, ctx Rotate/TopAndBottom items, ctx copy/cut clipboard fallback + pastetext bind, zoom-out/footnote rebinds + sb-lang, datetime dialog, caption dialog. Serialized dispatch (af parallel kills opencode). Word canon: Ctrl+Hyphen=en-dash, Ctrl+Minus=zoom-out.

defaults.commit_style: parity: promote <rows> via L2M product work

tasks.title: Docserver protect demo-doc fallback + promote protect row
steps: ROOT CAUSE: POST /api/documents/{id}/protect uses state.store.get_content(&id) which 404s for the harness demo.docx; the sibling GET handler uses demo_or_stored(&state, &id) (editor_docs.rs:76). Make document_protect use the same demo_or_stored fallback (keep the ODT rejection above it).
Verify Rust: cargo test -p wo-docserver --lib (nightly toolchain; test_protect_locks_document_against_save must stay green). Run in server/.
Promote protect.protect-document with the binding above (drop xfail; note 'PROMOTED 2026-11-07: protect POST demo fallback -> applyProtectionView sets contenteditable=false').
Verify: bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh 432
Commit ONLY the two listed files.

tasks.title: Compare/combine loaders accept array shape + promote both rows
steps: ROOT CAUSE: GET /api/documents returns a bare JSON array (editor_docs.rs:502) but loadCompareDocuments (~editor.js:7665) and loadCombineDocuments (~7742) read data.documents -> undefined -> selects stay placeholder-only. Backstage already handles both shapes (bsDocsCache logic ~10638): use `Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.documents || [])` in both loaders.
The runner peer-doc pre (contract-runner.cjs) POSTs /api/documents/new so the select has a second doc; pickFirstOption selects option index 1.
Promote both rows with the bindings above (drop xfail).
Verify: bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh 433
Commit ONLY the two listed files. Do NOT touch the runner.

tasks.title: Add Rotate + Top-and-Bottom ctx items, promote rows
steps: Add a Rotate 90° ctx item: [data-ctx="Rotate90"] with data-showif="image" in the image ctx group, wired to the same handler the right panel uses (rp-image-rotate -> applyImageRotate90). i18n key e.g. Ctx.Rotate90 (add en+de to i18n.js).

Add a Top and Bottom ctx item: [data-ctx="TopAndBottom"] with data-showif="image", applying the center/inline wrap (same as the wrap control's center option -> the object gains class obj-center; mirror what the existing wrap handler does).
If the ctx menu is built from index.html markup, add the items there; if items are registered in editor.js, add them there. Either way the selectors above must exist after a right-click on an image.
Promote ctx.rotate (ctx-imgops.json) and ctx.top-and-bottom (ctx-wrap.json) with the bindings above (drop xfail).
Verify: bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh 433 && (cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && /usr/bin/node --test ctx-menu.test.mjs label-parity.test.mjs)
Commit ONLY the five listed files.

tasks.title: ctx copy/cut clipboard fallback + pastetext bind, promote 3 rows
steps: NOTE: tests/parity/parity-overrides.json may not exist — if it does not, skip it (only touch ctx-residual.json and shortcut-real.json plus editor.js).

ctx Copy/Cut handlers: after the existing execCommand('copy'/'cut') call, add a fallback navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(getSelection() || '')) so headless/no-activation environments still fill the system clipboard (guard: only if clipboard write is available; catch rejections). Keep the existing DOM effect for cut (delete selection).

Bind Ctrl+Shift+V (Control+Shift+KeyV) to the paste-as-plain-text path: read navigator.clipboard.readText() and insert the plain text (same code path as the toolbar paste-text fallback / richPaste text-only branch).
The ctx-menu pre places the caret over word 1 and right-clicks (selection persists through right-click in Chromium) — copy/cut therefore operate on a real non-empty selection.
Promote ctx.copy and ctx.cut (ctx-residual.json) and shortcut.pastetextwithoutformat (shortcut-real.json) with the bindings above (drop xfail).
Verify: bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh 434 && (cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && /usr/bin/node --test ctx-menu.test.mjs label-parity.test.mjs)
Commit ONLY the touched listed files.

tasks.title: Rebind Ctrl+Minus zoom-out (en-dash to Ctrl+Hyphen) + Ctrl+Alt+F footnote + sb-lang click, promote 4 rows
steps: WORD CANON: optional hyphen/en-dash inserts are NOT Ctrl+Minus (that is zoom-out). Rebind the existing en-dash keydown handler (ev.code Minus, !shift !alt, currently inserting U+2013) to Control+Hyphen (ev.code Hyphen), and wire plain Ctrl+Minus to zoomOut() (same as the statusbar zoom-out button).
Update the shortcut.endash row key to Control+Hyphen (binding above, keep passing).
Promote shortcut.zoomout with the binding above (pre list + post #btn-zoom-reset already reset zoom to 1.0; drop xfail).

Control+Alt+F currently opens the backstage — keep that ONLY when it does not conflict; if the existing handler uses ev.code KeyF with ctrl+alt, move the footnote call to insertFootnote() instead (insertFootnote inserts the footnote block whose text contains 'Footnote text'). Promote shortcut.insertfootnotenow (key-insert.json).

sb-lang: make the statusbar language label clickable — click opens a small language menu (element with id sb-lang-menu, items with data-lang codes), picking an item sets the document language and updates the label. Promote statusbar.english-united-states with the binding above (post clicks the en-US item; assertion = label text contains 'English (US)'). Ensure the DEFAULT doc language is NOT already English (US) (otherwise text-mutation cannot observe a change) — e.g. default de-DE, or have the menu always re-apply so the label text updates.

statusbar.btn-doc-lang: if a second statusbar lang control exists (#sb-doc-lang), wire it to the same language set and promote with bindings2 above; if the row is the same control as #sb-lang, promote it with the same binding shape (selector #sb-lang + post en-US pick).
Verify: bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh 435 && (cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && /usr/bin/node --test statusbar.test.mjs shortcuts-gate.test.mjs label-parity.test.mjs)
Commit ONLY the touched listed files.
